purpose: Platform-neutral synthetic falsification of command-response identification, observation-history sufficiency, and equivalent encodings. No vehicle or controller trials.

hidden_memory.indistinguishable_probe: opposite inputs three intervals before origin; supplied last two commands and three observations equal

encoding.system: two-dimensional smooth nonlinear driven recurrence, specified in source before fitting

selection: No recipe changes, no hyperparameter search, all 27 planned fits reported, including failures.
interpretation: Three synthetic data replications are not platform validation, confidence bounds, or proof of a unique cause of the previous Cascade failure. The history counterexample is constructed; encoding results are measured after decoding to the same coordinates.
